question: What salvific power is sought from the goddess called Durgamā in endless suffering?
premises: Existence can be difficult, born of evil deeds, and endless.
Such existence entails the pain of coming and going.
The goddess Durgamā is asked to remove that pain.
inference: Though difficult to approach, Durgamā is invoked to remove the endless pain of transmigration.
plain_english: O Durgamā, remove the endless pain of coming and going in this difficult existence born of evil deeds.
